correctness.rationale: At ab=3/4 the exact 3×4 continuous fiber is explicitly derived from the published rational-density matrix formula. For every b∈[11/4,13/4], the two lower rows equal c=2−3/b because all eight arguments modulo three lie in [1/4,11/4] and precisely the two nearest translates contribute. The top row differs in its first entry by |b−3|/b; rank is 2 off b=3 and 1 at b=3. Continuity and the Zibulski–Zeevi rank criterion rigorously imply non-frame. Exact arithmetic checker passes 406 rational tests; finite testing does not replace proof.

value.rationale: Lemvig–Nielsen explicitly identify nonoptimality of general rational-density nonframe bands as an open structural issue, and the exact geometry of the second-order spline frame set remains undetermined. For the natural low denominator 3/4, this theorem doubles the excluded interval halfwidth around b=3 and supplies a full exact three-by-four fiber rank classification, yielding a reproducible structural nonframe region not implied by the all-rational general bound.
